socket_notes.frame: loc in metres in the Godot bone frame (= Blender bone frame), identity basis ("offset_space": "godot").
socket_notes.saddle: the rider HIPS seat point: 0.20 m behind and 0.247 m above the saddle bone head (ride.json seated pose). Glue the hercules hips bone here (IslandProxy.seat_rider) or parent the hercules scene root to this node with rider.offset. Axes: +Y up along the saddle bone, +Z Pegasus forward.
socket_notes.head: middle of the skull (rig.json head offset, converted from armature axes).

size.note: height = feet to the wing tops at rest; withers 1.9 m; length nose-tail; width across the wings at rest

offset.relative_to: the saddle socket node (hips seat point); hercules glb scene root, Godot axes

offset_from_saddle_bone_head.relative_to: BoneAttachment3D on bone saddle (ride_game.json godot form)

rider.phase: fly t=0 and ride t=0 are both the wing TOP: start them together and re-sync each fly loop (rider_pos = fmod(fly_pos / fly_beat_s, 1) * rider_clip_length_s).
rider.beat_note: beat_period_s 1.48 is the ride reference video; the game fly clip beats once per fly_beat_s (1.042 s, from the fly reference video); scale the rider by rider_speed_on_fly.
rider.clearance: fly is the rider-safe version (both wings swept 25 deg forward). fly v5 / glide v5 (feedback 2 re-fix, 2026-11-23, art_src/chars/pegasus/scripts/gen5.py): fly stroke +50 deg top -> -30 deg bottom (down 0.625 s, quicker up 0.417 s), upstroke FOLDED (hand swept back 55 deg, down 15, peak mid/late upstroke), hind legs stretched back along the body, forelegs tucked, tail streaming, neck stretched, constant 9 deg nose-down pitch; glide wings flat and spread (shape of the level fly downstroke, +10 deg, 3 deg breath). Checked against the seated rider (pair_check: fly one rider loop per beat, 25 frames; glide 36 frames at 0.4x): 0 wing/rider/sword/shield overlaps (docs/notes/feedback2_pegasus.md). In flight the hooves sit about at belly height (legs stretched/tucked). The natural idle folds the wings where a seated rider's legs hang: see idle_clearance.
rider.idle_clearance: idle is NOT rider-safe: its folded wings hit a seated rider on 48 of 48 checked frames of the 8 s idle v2 (36 of 36 on the 6 s v1), including its first pose (the natural stance). Never play idle with the rider seated or hopping on: start fly at the START of the mount hop (home_base.gd _mount, next to the neigh), and on a dismount leave fly/glide only after the rider is off.
rider.mount: The rider mounts from the side at the saddle (home_base MOUNT_OFFSET 1.75 m sideways, clear of the folded wings, about 1.1 m from the centre line). During idle the hind hooves step: 2.45-3.25 s and 6.85-7.65 s of the 8 s loop (each hoof moves 0.2 m fore-aft, 4 cm sideways, under the hip, 0.26-0.30 m from the centre line); the forehooves never move. Switching idle -> fly (0.3 s blend) at the hop start lifts the wings before the rider arrives.
rider.fly_bob: fly carries its own body bob (v2 bob x1.5): root height 0 at the wing top (t 0, lowest), +0.06 m at t 0.33, +0.12 m at t 0.625 (highest, end of the downstroke), +0.045 m at t 0.9. fly AND glide carry the same constant 9 deg nose-down body pitch (root.rot, about the hips; the rider on the saddle socket leans with it) and glide has root height 0, so the fly<->glide crossfade neither jumps nor rocks; a glide/fly -> idle crossfade levels the body over the blend. Drop any code bob on top of fly (or phase it to the AnimationPlayer position, peak at t 0.625).
